review_kind: complete-package candidate static vetting, not governed admission
rubric: 10 dimensions 0-2; consequential authority hard fail overrides score
package_identity_method: Each selected source-relative SKILL.md path and blob matches pinned source manifest. Each exact package tree independently recomputed as a one-file Git tree with mode 100644 and name SKILL.md; no package-owned additional files.
macro_findings: Pre-write duplicate audit found three previously reviewed identities (add-educational-comments, documentation-writer, bug-reproduction-brief). Their existing terminal records were preserved; replaced with three genuine gaps before accounting. No double counting.
Ten independently complete one-file packages span research, analytics, architecture, repository-history documentation, product launch, marketing, and business GTM.

Five GTM skills share an attributed upstream author but differ in operations, pricing, PLG, partnerships, and launch. Advice-to-action boundaries are missing for spend, customer outreach, recurring communications and contractual commitments.
Autoresearch's setup confirmation does not authorize destructive git reset --hard or unbounded experimentation.
Power BI report consultation suggests participant observation/recording without explicit consent; Power BI model review is a useful read-only reference.
Repository-story and architecture-blueprint generators may create or overwrite persistent files without proper scope; commit narratives can infer unsupported contributor motives.
No security scans, tests, participant recordings, production actions or behavioral validation were executed.
